listings.title: Baled clear PET bottles — container loads from Barka
listings.summary: Colour-sorted, baled post-consumer PET bottles. Caps, rings and labels removed where required. Loaded at Sohar or Muscat.
listings.packing: Baled, 200–400 kg per bale, colour sorted
listings.priceNote: Quote per load, same working day
listings.description:
Baled post-consumer PET bottles from Oman, colour sorted into clear, light blue, green and mixed. Caps, rings and labels are removed where the buyer requires it, and every bale is weighed on a certified weighbridge with the ticket kept with the load.

The material comes from factories, municipalities and collectors across Muscat, Barka, Sohar and Al Batinah, so supply continues through the month rather than in one-off lots. Bales run roughly 200–400 kg and are strapped for container stuffing at our Barka yard, at Sohar Port or at Port Sultan Qaboos.

Suitable for flake producers and recyclers in Oman, the GCC and worldwide. Send the grade, quantity and destination port on WhatsApp and we reply with photos of the actual lot and a firm price the same working day. One 40ft container is the usual minimum; smaller trial loads can be discussed.

listings.title: HDPE 100 pipe offcuts — black and natural, cut or granulated
listings.summary: PE100 pressure-pipe offcuts, coils and factory rejects in several SDR grades. Clean, UV-stabilised material for regrind.
listings.packing: Cut lengths or granulated to your screen size
listings.priceNote: Quote per load, same working day
listings.description:
HDPE 100 (PE100) pressure-pipe offcuts, coiled lengths and factory rejects, black or natural, in several SDR grades. The material is clean, UV-stabilised and free of fittings, so it regrinds into pipe, sheet or injection parts without surprises.

We can cut to length for a customer who stuffs containers themselves, or granulate to an agreed screen size before loading. Each load is weighed on the yard weighbridge and photographed before it leaves, and the loading report travels with the invoice.

Collected from contractors, utilities and pipe producers in Oman; supplied to regrind and pipe producers in Oman and the GCC. Tell us the SDR grade, colour and tonnage you need and we will send photos of what is in the yard that week.

listings.title: Wanted: washed PET bottle flakes, under 1% moisture
listings.summary: Regular monthly volumes of hot-washed, colour-sorted PET flake from producers in Oman or the GCC.
listings.description:
We are buying washed PET bottle flake on a continuing basis: hot-washed, colour sorted, dried to under 1% moisture, with PVC content kept low. Clear, light blue and green streams are all of interest, and IV is tested on every lot we take.

Suppliers can be in Oman or the GCC. We agree the specification in writing first — colour mix, moisture, contamination limits, packing — then confirm the price against that specification rather than against a headline number.

Collections can be arranged, or material can be delivered to our Barka yard where it is sampled and weighed before payment. If you run a wash line and have a consistent output, send the specification and a photo of a typical bale or big bag and we will respond with terms.
